body:
Follow-up from task:5c7e159c3503cecf (its note 10). Each project's committed code store (`.solace/store.db`) holds a board event log, and older Solace builds wrote whole task copies there, notes and questions included. That breaks this feature's promise to commit tasks without their conversations or run details.

### Do

- Write and read board events in the local, ignored events file (`.solace/tasks/events.db`) instead of the shared store.
- The first time a project upgrades, empty the old event table in its shared store once.

### Done when

- A freshly upgraded project's committed store holds no board events.
- The board still gets live updates.

### Out of scope

- The store's other run tables (work records, rejected changes, who-changed-what, undo records).
- Cleaning notes already in past git commits.

### For the worker

- Writer: `board::task_model.event` (callers `board::task_model.recover_project`, `board::server.serve`). Readers: `board::server.Events` (`snapshot`, `members_changed`, `next`). Table created in `store_core.LATER_TABLES`.
- `tasks::store.events` already has a project column and task events.
title: share: keep board events out of the shared store
